breaking.change: The pixel preset renders 270 lines (Stylise.pixelHeight 270, ArtPixels.logicalHeight 270) instead of 224, so a 1080p output scales by a whole 4x and fills the frame without a border.
breaking.fix: Games on the pixel preset see more of the scene vertically (and horizontally, which follows the aspect); frame cameras, tile counts and sprite sizes for 270 lines. A game that wants 224 sets Stylise.pixelHeight 224 and ArtPixels.logicalHeight 224 in its own look.
